notes: Discovery boundary spec (issue 20260929-cloudflare-feature-coverage-automation §1-2): per-profile roots into the resolved upstream candidate — @cloudflare/workers-types index.d.ts declarations and the wrangler config-schema.json subtree. compat/inventory/extract.mjs turns this into the candidate inventory; compat/check-inventory.mjs verifies it. 'container' values: 'global' for top-level ambient declarations, a quoted module name for declare module blocks (members resolved through export = namespaces), 'namespace:<name>' for ambient namespace members. 'names' are case-sensitive globs where '*' matches any suffix/prefix; bare '*' matches every exported member.

workflows-core.description: Workflow execution semantics: WorkflowStep/WorkflowEntrypoint surface, retry, timeout, sleep/sleepUntil, waitForEvent, lifecycle states, replay, rollback, subscription event stream, serialization, durable execution semantics.

workflow-host.description: Hosting surface for running workflows: Worker entry surface (ExportedHandler/WorkerEntrypoint/ExecutionContext), source module loading, compatibility_date/flags, wrangler Workflows configuration, vars/secrets, scheduling, Workflow binding and WorkflowInstance handles.

binding-adapters.description: Binding families workflows.mbt.json adapters target: KV, D1, R2, Queues, Services — wrangler binding config plus the workers-types binding interfaces.

workers-platform.description: The rest of the Workers platform (AI, Durable Objects, other runtime APIs/bindings/deploy management). Deferred: discovered items are recorded but never enter an active denominator.
